label: Counter
when: figures the owner gave, shown as animated numbers, rings or bars (years in business, percentages)
rules: Only when the request gives the numbers: never invent a figure or reuse the example's. One counter per figure, in a row of columns (the example shows the three styles; a row uses one). The wrapper holds optional icons, counter-child-number, a spectra/content (the label as "text") and, for a bar only, counter-child-progress-bar last. "endNumber" is the figure, counted up from 0; "prefix"/"suffix" add "%" or "+"; "thousandSeparator" from 1000. "simple" is the default; "circular" and "bar" fill toward "totalNumber" (default 100): percentages only, with "progressColor" a palette slug.
